xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: CASE CLOSED. Initially, Customs imposed penalties of Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,00,000. However, CONCOR challenged the penalty at CESTAT and it was reduced to Rs 35,000 as per the order dated 09.08.2024. A pre-deposit of Rs 33,750, which is 7.5% of the total penalty amount of Rs 4,50,000, was made. With the total penalty amount now reduced to Rs 35,000, a balance payment of Rs 1,250 was paid to Customs, and the case is now closed.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Notice: It is alleged that CONCOR has availed excess ITC in GSTR-3B when compared with the ITC available in GSTR-2A for the FY 2020-21 by an amount of ₹ 1,11,321.00 (IGST: ₹ 1,05,601, CGST: ₹ 2,860, SGST: ₹ 2,860) CONCOR Reply: CONCOR has submitted a reconciliation of ITC available as per GSTR-2A and ITC availed in GSTR-3B for the financial year 2020-21 and FY 2019-20. Personal hearing was held on 09-01-2025 and additional submissions were also made before the notice issuing authorities.

Notice: Show Cause Notice SCN Ref. No. 129/CGST/MS/AE/ ADC/Gr-02/CONCOR/24-25 dated 03.08.2024 (SCN in short) has been issued covering the following points:-
(i) Excess ITC availed in GSTR-3B (iv) Ineligible ITC availed blocked u/s 17(5) (vi) GST not paid on services received under RCM (ix) ITC availed for CGST & SGST of different state vendor (POS). (x) GST charged at lower rate on demurrage (xi) GST has been short paid on account of services provided under SAC 996711 and 996719 for the period from July 2017 to March 2023 CONCOR Reply: (i) CONCOR has submitted a reconciliation of ITC available as per GSTR-2A and ITC availed in GSTR-3B substantiating the fact no excess ITC has been availed (iv) ITC availed is of eligible nature only (vi) Services pointed out are of exempt nature and not taxable under RCM (ix) No ITC has been availed for CGST & SGST of different state vendor (POS) (x) GST is charged at correct rate on demurrage (xi) Exempt services have not been considered by department while raising the order, Correct levy of GST has been discharged and no short payment is there on account of services provided under SAC 996711 and 996719 for the period from July 2017 to March 2023
